## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-fascicle Tang Vinaya digest by **Dàoxuān** 道宣 ([道宣](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E5%AE%A3), 596–667) preserving extracts and discussions of *Sìfēnlǜ* 四分律 material that did not find a home in his three principal Vinaya commentaries (*Xíngshì chāo* 行事鈔, *Jièběn shū* 戒本疏, *Suíjī jiémó shū* 隨機羯磨疏). *Shí* 拾 ("picking up") signals the *Yìchāo*'s status as a supplement to the main *Sìfēnlǜ* corpus.

**Abstract**

The *Shí píní yìchāo* is a less-studied but important Vinaya digest by Dàoxuān, supplying material that fell outside his three principal *Sìfēn* commentaries. Yuánzhào's preface confirms that the work had been transmitted continuously since Dàoxuān's time but had become textually corrupt and scarce by the eleventh century; Yuánzhào's *jiàokān* recension is the form preserved in the canon. The companion sub-commentary [KR6k0177](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0177) *Sìfēnlǜ shí píní yìchāo fǔyào jì* by **Yǔn Kān** 允堪 ([允堪](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%81%E5%A0%AA)) further attests to the work's standing in the Sòng *Lǜzōng* curriculum. Composition belongs to Dàoxuān's mature Vinaya period at Zhōngnán.
